name: SAFI Lead Intake & Gated Follow-Up (R-MKT-01, R-MKT-02)

nodes.name: Lead Intake Webhook
nodes.notes: Bound strictly to local Docker network / 127.0.0.1 (R-SEC-02).

assignments.name: preparedFollowup
assignments.value: ={{ 'Hello ' + ($json.body.leadName || 'Customer') + ', thank you for contacting us regarding: ' + ($json.body.inquiryText || 'your inquiry') + '. Here are available consultation times.' }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'ingested', executionId: $execution.id, conversationId: $json.conversationId, recipientEmail: $json.recipientEmail, preparedFollowup: $json.preparedFollowup, followupIdempotencyKey: $json.followupIdempotencyKey }) }}

nodes.name: Return Verified Intake Status to Gate
nodes.notes: Responds before triggering outbound gate submission to avoid per-conversation dispatch lock re-entrancy.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ conversationId: $json.conversationId, engine: 'n8n', operation: 'dispatch_followup', idempotencyKey: $json.followupIdempotencyKey, recipients: [$json.recipientEmail], payload: { conversationId: $json.conversationId, recipientEmail: $json.recipientEmail, messageBody: $json.preparedFollowup }, actor: { actorGuid: 'proxy-n8n-workflow', actorKind: 'PROXY', meetingContext: { source: 'n8n-lead-intake', executionId: $execution.id }, portContext: { port: 'n8n-internal' }, permissionProvenance: { role: 'WORKFLOW_PROXY' } } }) }}

nodes.name: Submit Controlled Effect to Gate Adapter (NO Direct Send)
nodes.notes: R-GATE-01: Never use direct SMTP/email/SMS nodes in n8n. Every controlled effect MUST pass through the Local Gate Adapter.

main.node: Return Verified Intake Status to Gate
Submit Controlled Effect to Gate Adapter (NO Direct Send)
